arr_scene_backend: Procedural full-population box scan; no truncation to uniform array capacity.
notes: Million-population validation targets the last instance with one ray, a dropped-group ray and a miss; it is not a million-object full-frame ARR timing.
Full stress method selection includes all 12 methods.
Small-scene CPU reference and analytic diagnostic maps retain their 32-object limit.
Direction budgets and triangulation modes are not changed on scene selection.
